text:
System Developer, Software Engineer.

ashish@ashjain.com 651-235-2629 github.com/ashishjain-repo linkedin.com/in/ashishjain1008 ashjain.com



Expected Dec 2026 Brigham Young University - Idaho, Rexburg, ID

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
Minor: Web Development
Concentration: Machine Learning
GPA: \(3.9/4.0\)






Upcoming April 2026 The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Salt Lake City, UT

Migrating the existing Angular codebase to React, with also consuming existing API’s
Helping with database design and query optimization.




May 2025 - Present Brigham Young University Idaho, Rexburg, ID

Automated BYUI Support Center workflows and maintained legacy Java Spring Boot applications.
Developed Team Dynamix iPaaS solutions, reducing manual intervention by 50%.
Implemented Genesys support and troubleshot complex system issues in production environments.
Streamlined internal processes.




May 2025 - Jul 2025 Vivacity Tech PBC, St. Paul, MN

Maintained and enhanced the customer-facing application for managing device telemetry and incident reporting.
Developed new features using React.js, Express.js, Redis, and PostgreSQL that automated incident reporting, improving response efficiency.
Collaborated with a cross-functional team in an Agile development using Jira and Confluence.




Apr 2024 - Present Brigham Young University Idaho, Rexburg, ID

Mentor 100+ students in advanced SQL, database design, and optimization, contributing to 20% higher success rates.
Conduct weekly lab sessions and provide one-on-one tutoring on complex database concepts.




Sep 2024 - Nov 2024 UpUnikSelf Inc., Dover, DE

Built responsive B2B platform with Next.js and TypeScript, integrating 100+ database tables.
Optimized performance: 40% reduced API latency, 30% smaller bundle size, and 35% faster queries.
Implemented responsive design and worked with backend teams to design efficient API endpoints.







Expected Dec 2026

Engineered a full-stack IoT platform using a Java Spring Boot RestAPI Backend and a Vue.js frontend with TailwindCSS and Pinia.
Architected a real-time data ingestion system using Mosquitto MQTT, storing data in a PostgreSQL database configured with a Primary/Replica architecture for scalability.
Implemented Redis caching to optimize data retrieval and a robust, role-based access control system.





Designed and developed a responsive landing page using modern Vue.js frontend and TailwindCSS.
Integrated a serverless backend with Cloudflare Workers to manage API endpoints and automate dynamic functions like contact form submissions.
Implemented a component-based architecture and managed application state with Pinia.





Developed a collaborative floor booking platform for students, simplifying the apartment search and application process.
Utilized SvelteKit for the frontend and Supabase (BaaS) for real-time data management, authentication, and file storage.
Architected a GraphQL API to provide a single, flexible endpoint for data fetching, reducing over-fetching and improving application speed.





Developed a Vue.js web app with TMDB API integration, optimized caching, and reduced load times by 30%.
Implemented modular architecture and CI/CD pipeline deployment on Netlify with a responsive design.
